attribution: The cluster-wide gate refused the intentionally sealed scheduling template during the seven clean-posture assertions (eight PostgreSQL connection refusals in that window). Independently, post-run inspection found two clock fixtures restored reformatted definitions and historical teleconsult DDL left the capture routine without the later encounter-specific consent check. Both fixture problems needed correction; the verifier was not relaxed.

failure_attributions.cause: The valid runtime URL authenticated; the cluster-wide inspection still encountered the sealed scheduling template. The db-posture Python process refused and Make returned 2; this was not a credential rejection.
failure_attributions.error: AssertionError: Make returned 2; expected 0 (database posture check failed)
